maya-cs: Heads-up: Lumina Health asked for a Canada demo route next Tue 09:00 EST. They want a short 36h qps bump (+400) and CIDR allowlist. Renewal in 20 days; positive demo may trigger an expansion.
raj-se: Paste CIDRs and host/SNI preference?
maya-cs: They gave these CIDRs and will use host header match pilot.lumina.health. Auto-revoke after 36h, alert 3h before expiry.
CIDRs:
198.51.100.128/25
203.0.113.64/26
2001:db8:abcd::/64
olga-sre: Capacity looks fine for ca-central if we reserve burst pool. Recommend soft burst and compact-model fallback at p95>350ms.
hannah-legal: Need attestation + confirm no PHI leaves Canada; set logs retention 24h and redact identifiers.
tom-support: Renewal note added, NPS 7 last quarter. Mark high-touch.
raj-se: Draft ops (hold for legal attestation):
redwood edge allowlist add --region ca-central --cidr 198.51.100.128/25 --account lumina
redwood edge allowlist add --region ca-central --cidr 203.0.113.64/26 --account lumina
redwood routes create --account lumina --region ca-central --host "pilot.lumina.health" --route pilot-ca
redwood quotas update --account lumina --route pilot-ca --qps +400 --duration 36h --auto-revoke --pre-expiry-alert 3h
provision-bot: Ticket LH-9801 opened and provisioning started. ETA ~2.5h.
olga-sre: Provision done, auto-revoke scheduled, redaction & retention set. Smoke: p50=130ms p95=290ms. Monitoring dashboards attached to LH-9801.
maya-cs: Thanks team 44D I'll coordinate demo run and report results to commercial.
